src/sim.js: "A week. I am not a patient man, but I am a curious one."
"Atlanta. I will tell the operator."
"Before my people meet you: you will say, on the record, that Esmeralda receives you as a guest. Not a government."
"Good. The ministry will hear from me in the morning."
"Her uncle banks with me. She will answer within the hour. That is two things now."
"I could not decide for you. Six hours lost."
"I have a name in Baca. Give me six hours."
"I told them Atlanta. Do not make me a liar."
"I will see what the minister can spare. Call it a courtesy."
"Inspector Sosā. Come back for the hearing and this ends quietly. Stay, and your brother's name goes on the warrant too."
"Jet found in Susana. The crew needs a destination. Atlanta, or wait for Salek?"
"Leave it with me. Six hours."
"Nothing yet. They want more time."
"Rādiô Portô Venla. We hear you are on a yacht off the coast. Can you confirm?"
"Ten hours, and you understand what I asked."
"Thank you. My people will be at the post."
"Thank you. Sosā's people are in Santa Laura tonight, by the way. Not here."
"The crew is happy. The apron saw you pay them."
"The crew will not confirm without a destination. Decide."
"The minister has other guests this weekend."
"The ministry has not called back. I will try again if you ask."
"The operator just had a call from the minister's office. We are good."
"The party meets tonight. Send your endorsement before midnight. You gave your word."
"The transfer papers are with your brother. Sign tonight, or I stop making calls."
"Then call Salek soon. The crew will not wait on us forever."
"Then we have nothing to discuss. Good luck with the pilot."
"Then you will cross like anyone else."
"Think about it. I will call again."
"Two men in a car at the yard gate, asking about a woman. Or a man. Midnight or never."
"Vélez is not answering. I can try again, or ask Salek to reach her uncle."
"Your ministry threatened the operator’s license. He wants Esmeraldan backing or a crew bonus."
. Your immunity is gone, a warrant is out and Esmeralda has closed its airfields to your flight.
./data.js
